result.description:
Coffiction operates as a café in Deagon, Queensland, offering breakfast, brunch, lunch, specialty coffee, beverages, and café-style dining within a structured commercial kitchen environment. The business focuses on delivering fresh, high-quality meals, efficient kitchen coordination, and excellent customer service across all trading periods.

About the Role
The Cook position is responsible for cooking menu items and supporting day-to-day kitchen operations within a fast-paced commercial kitchen environment. The role supports food service delivery by ensuring food is cooked consistently, efficiently, and in line with established recipes, kitchen procedures, and service standards.

Location: Shop 6, 55–75 Braun Street, Deagon QLD 4017
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $80,000 to $85,000 + Superannuation

Key Responsibilities
 1. Examine food ingredients and foodstuffs to ensure quality and freshness
 2. Regulate temperatures of ovens, grills, fryers, and other cooking equipment during food preparation
 3. Cook menu items in line with established recipes and kitchen procedures
 4. Season food during cooking to maintain consistency and taste standards
 5. Portion food, plate dishes, and add sauces, gravies, and garnishes before service
 6. Store food and ingredients appropriately in temperature-controlled storage areas
 7. Prepare meals in accordance with dietary and customer requirements where required
 8. Assist with monitoring stock levels and food usage within the kitchen
 9. Maintain cleanliness and organisation of kitchen workstations, equipment, and storage areas
 10. Follow food safety, hygiene, and workplace health and safety procedures at all times
 11. Work collaboratively with kitchen staff to support smooth kitchen operations

Candidate Requirements
 1. Relevant qualification such as Certificate III in Commercial Cookery or equivalent
 2. Minimum 1–2 years of full-time relevant work experience in a similar role
 3. Experience working within a café, commercial kitchen, or hospitality environment
 4. Strong understanding of cooking techniques and kitchen workflow
 5. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced kitchen environment
 6. Knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards
 7. Strong teamwork and communication skills
 8. Only candidates currently residing in Australia will be shortlisted

How to Apply
Please submit your resume outlining your relevant experience and suitability for the position. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Date of Ads Posted: 13 July 2026
Last Day of Application: 9 August 2026

ARA Security, as a part of the ARA Group, is a well established security company that focuses on safety, quality and risk management. An employee-owned company established in 2001, ARA is comprised of the following operating divisions:

1. ARA Fire & Security 
2. ARA Electrical
3. ARA Property Services
4. ARA Products

We are a leading security provider and deliver high-quality, customer driven security and locksmith solutions to clients in specialist industries in a broad range of sectors including defence, government, financial and corporate.
 
ARA is seeking a talented and experienced Human Resource Manager to join their HR team to help support the growth.

- Develop, implement, monitor, review, and evaluate human resource strategies, policies, and plans that support organisational goals and business objectives
- Provide guidance and support to managers on best practices for recruitment, selection, onboarding, training and employee development

- Excellent recruitment, interviewing, and talent acquisition skills
- High level of integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality 
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills 
- Min 1 year of experience in a related field
- Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in a relevant field  

If you meet the above criteria and you're interested in contributing to an organisation that values the highest level of quality in everything it sets out to achieve, we want to hear from you!
Apply now for this exciting opportunity to be part of the team at ARA Security!

result.description:
Our client, Tech Envision, is a technology solutions provider located in Warrnambool, Victoria, specialising in telecommunications, networking, information technology (IT) infrastructure, and digital technology services. The company delivers end-to-end solutions including network design, telecommunications system deployment, infrastructure implementation, technical support, and ongoing maintenance for business clients. 

Tech Envision is seeking a Telecommunications Field Engineer to install, commission, maintain, troubleshoot, and support telecommunications and network infrastructure at customer sites. The role involves delivering field engineering services, ensuring reliable network performance, resolving technical issues, and providing high-quality customer support while complying with industry standards and safety requirements.

The annual salary for this position is $75,000 to $85,000.

Duties include:

•	Conduct site surveys to assess customer requirements, network infrastructure, equipment locations, and installation feasibility for telecommunications projects. 

•	Install, configure, commission, and test telecommunications equipment, including routers, switches, wireless devices, fibre optic systems, Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) solutions, and network hardware to meet technical specifications. 

•	Perform fault diagnosis, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on telecommunications networks and associated equipment to ensure continuous service availability. 

•	Monitor network performance using diagnostic tools and protocol analysers, identifying faults and implementing technical solutions to optimise system reliability and efficiency. 

•	Configure Internet Protocol (IP) networking, routing, switching, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), and wireless communication systems in accordance with customer requirements and industry standards. 

•	Conduct fibre optic cable testing, splicing verification, signal measurements, and certification using specialised test equipment to ensure network integrity and performance. 

•	Prepare technical documentation, including installation reports, network diagrams, test results, maintenance records, and equipment configuration details for project completion and compliance purposes. 

•	Provide onsite technical support and troubleshooting for customers, resolving hardware, software, connectivity, and telecommunications service issues within agreed service levels. 

•	Coordinate with Project Managers, Network Engineers, vendors, and customers during installation, commissioning, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure successful project delivery. 

•	Ensure all telecommunications installations and field activities comply with workplace health and safety requirements, telecommunications regulations, and company quality standards. 

•	Perform system upgrades, firmware updates, equipment replacements, and network expansion activities with minimal disruption to customer operations. 

•	Assist in evaluating new telecommunications technologies, conducting field testing and performance validation, and recommending improvements to enhance network capability, reliability, and customer service outcomes.

Qualifications:

•	Must have at least one (1) year of experience.

•	Should hold a Diploma or higher qualification in a relevant field.
